Kevin Trudeau lived in a 900 square foot apartment with a sheet covering the window because he was broke.

Every day he pictured himself in a mansion - not wanting it, actually feeling like he already owned several of them, worth tens of millions.

He kept that feeling anyway, broke apartment and all. His point: by the time the mansions were real, nothing on the inside had to change. He'd already felt it before it happened.

That's the piece most people skip.
